svg.text: One state root, one writer, many read-only faces. Orange solid lines are writes, purple dashed lines are read-only.

svg.text: There are two read paths: the typed IPC served by the host (operations such as QueryEvents and SubscribeEvents), or the offline read face actingledger. Clients never write to the evidence plane and never hold the ledger writer; the external read-only console

svg.text: A failed append is not proof of absence: on a fatal append or settlement error the writer terminates, informs subscribers and returns the error. Every statement above traces to a file in the repository; the one thing that could not be established from the material at hand,
